good: Speed sense is good: blur, speed lines, boost flames and a clear drift with smoke and a DRIFT! label
Varied world: city, coast, bridge pillars and cliffs, with a sunset sky and a styled Burnout-like HUD
With only W held the car hit the wall and scraped, so there is no auto-steer
bad: Takedowns stay at 0 in every frame and the player is stuck in 7th or 8th, so no takedown or slow-motion card is shown
The car spends a lot of time grinding along walls in a spray of sparks, and the rivals are mostly out of sight
Low-poly buildings and flat grass look generic, and no walkthrough sheet was provided
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It has a fast, good-looking arcade feel with a solid drift and boost, but the rivals barely show up and I never saw a takedown.

good: Visible sideways drifts, smoke and distinct boost effects.
Clear HUD with reacting speed and boost indicators.
Wide roads with city, bridge and coastal bends.
bad: Prolonged wall scraping dominates the drive; effects sometimes obscure the car.
Blocky scenery and flat lighting limit visual polish.
No takedown demonstrated and no walkthrough sheet supplied.
gpt-6.1-sol-xhigh.one_line: The drifting and boost look entertaining, but the endless barrier grinding and absent combat leave it feeling like a rough racing prototype.

good: Drift, boost threshold and HUD all behave: shift throws smoke with a 'DRIFT!' callout, boost needs a filled bar and shows exhaust flames
No auto-steer — holding only W drives you off the road into the barrier, and A/D visibly steer into the right wall
Track has real variety (lit city, coastal cliff run, elevated bridge/viaduct, tunnel-like section) and the HUD is complete: speed, boost bar, 8TH/8, LAP 1/3, takedowns
bad: Takedowns never once happened in the filmed drive — the counter stays 0 and the player sat 8TH/8 for 70s, so slamming rivals into walls is unproven
Visuals are flat low-poly: blocky orange car, grainy/static-looking asphalt, plain gradient sky and daylight with no motion blur or FOV punch, so 260 km/h reads as 'floating along'
No walkthrough sheet was provided, and there is no visible speed-effect work (no blur, no camera shake, no roadside rush)
minimax-m3.1-flash-free.one_line: Drifting and boost genuinely work, but it's cardboard cars on a flat gray road and in two minutes of driving I never saw one takedown.
